The scheduler only takes UTC times, so the fix is a cron entry that tracks Chicago time. Chicago is UTC-5 until DST ends on Nov 1, then UTC-6. Keeping 17:30 Chicago year-round means changing the entry on Nov 1, or setting it up on a host that runs in Chicago time.
